audit.method: Every enumerated blob read from the specified Git tree; remoteFetched identifies a fresh verification ref. Source byte counts and canonical UTF-8 LF/binary hashes checked. All frozen edition hashes checked. Each unique immutable Git archive blob is decompressed once; every logical original entry is compared to its verified compressed/raw byte counts and SHA-256. No mutable-file timestamp or runtime-proof shortcut.

scope: Actual non-force atomic main/edition101/tag push, fetched and independently audited from Git blobs. Actual local-model whole data-to-creation chat workflows, interruption/resume, source-derived contracts, four-state audits and fresh-input whole-skill reuse passed. Independent read-only review and retained failed attempts are documented. Retained initial failures are part of the original evidence. Post-push CI is separate.

analysis.scope: Independent original recorded CSV arithmetic, full source lineage, actual browser cells in four states, model compute receipts and restart/reuse identities. Complete elapsed time includes deliberate pause/restart; not a speed comparison.
